## Snowcloak (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
CN Large aberration  
**Init** +3; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 30 ft., keen scent, Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +4 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 55 (5d8+15); regeneration 3 (acid, fire)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +4, **Will** +6  
**Immune** paralysis, poison; **Resist** cold 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)  
**Melee** 2 claws +6 (1d4+3 plus paralysis), 2 bites +5 (1d6+3), tail slap +0 (1d12+1)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with tail)  
**Special Attacks** paralysis (Fort DC 15, 1d4+1 rounds)  
**Spell-like Abilities** CL 5th, concentration +6  

3/day—blur, gust of wind (DC 13), magic missile  


**Statistics**


**Str** 12, **Dex** 16, **Con** 17, **Int** 9, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 20  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw); Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Fly +9, Perception +10, Stealth +7 (+15 in ice or snow); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth in ice or snow  
**Languages** Auran  
**SQ** wind rider  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any cold  
**Organization** solitary or drift (2-8)  
**Treasure** none  


**Special Abilities**


**Keen Scent (Ex)** A snowcloak can pinpoint creatures by scent within 180 feet, and smell blood at a range of 1 mile.  

**Wind Rider (Su)** A snowcloak suffers no penalties from wind effects of anything less than tornado strength.  


**About**
